title: Otter samples manifest v1
description: Tab-separated samples manifest defining input FASTQ pairs for a project. Each row describes one sample with paired-end reads, optional group/batch metadata, and adapter sequences.

format.description: The samples manifest is a TSV file (tab-separated values), not JSON.

r1.description: Absolute or project-relative path to the mate 1 FASTQ file (required, paired-end).

r2.description: Absolute or project-relative path to the mate 2 FASTQ file (required, paired-end).

group.description: Optional experimental group label (e.g. treated, control).

adapter_r1.description: Optional adapter sequence for mate 1 (overrides workflow default).

adapter_r2.description: Optional adapter sequence for mate 2 (overrides workflow default).

unique_sample_ids.description: Every sample_id must be unique within the manifest.

non_empty_samples.description: The manifest must contain at least one sample record.

strict_columns.description: Unknown columns are rejected; only the canonical column set is allowed.

no_trailing_empty_lines.description: Empty lines within the body are skipped; a truly empty manifest is rejected.

examples.content:
sample_id	r1	r2	group	batch	adapter_r1	adapter_r2
